|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">クローラー収納型のダクトは、元来は鉱山で採掘物を集め、他の施設に輸送するために設計されたものである。今ではジャワたちがドロイド（や持って行けるものならなんでも）を吸い上げるために使っている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Magnetic suction duct.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on your sandcrawler. During your control phase, you may choose one character at the same place as the target. Draw destiny. If destiny > the character's ability, “suck up” that character (relocate to the related sandcrawler interior location card or the owner's Used Deck).

'''Lore:'''
A crawler-stowed duct originally designed to collect mine output and send it to other facilities. Jawas now use it to suck up droids (and anything else they can take).

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is 磁気吸引ダクト (magnetic suction duct).
